title: Bryant House, 146 Wilson Street, Bement, Piatt County, IL
notes: Significance: Abraham Lincoln and Stephen A. Douglas met at this site to discuss the format for the famous Lincoln-Douglas debates in 1858.
Unprocessed Field note material exists for this structure: FN-58, FN-59, FN-61
